answer_1.quote: In this paper, we argue that, with appropriate design, a single language model can be a powerful and versatile SE model. To this end, we propose LLaSE-G1, a LLaMA-based language model that incentivizes generalization capabilities across various SE tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use objective metrics to evaluate the performance of the baseline systems and our model. DNSMOS include speech quality (SIG), background noise quality (BAK), and overall quality (OVRL) of the audio. AECMOS consists of echo annoyance MOS (EMOS) and other degradation MOS (DMOS). PLCMOS is used to assess the quality of audio processed by PLC algorithms. SpeechBERTScore (SBS) is also employed to evaluate the semantic similarity between the enhanced audio and the reference audio. ... we calculate speaker similarity SimW B based on the WavLM-base-sv model to evaluate the performance.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted evaluations on subjective listening tests and user studies. The experimental setup and results are shown in Table . We primarily used the DNS blind test set for the subjective evaluation. A total of 12 participants were recruited, and each participant was asked to listen to 50 audio samples. The Mean Opinion Score (MOS) was calculated on a 5-point scale, ranging from 1 (poor quality) to 5 (excellent quality).
